cross_verification.note_en: Checked Vanuatu Department of Immigration and Passport Services 'Visit' page (visa categories/criteria/fees — no photo spec) and the Vanuatu eVisa Portal (evisa.gov.vu, official government MIDAS e-Visa system) — the latter is a JS-rendered single-page app and returned no extractable photo-requirement text via fetch or browser page-text. The department's passport page (see vu-passport.json) states photos must be 3.5cm × 4.5cm, but that text appears specifically on the citizen-passport page, not a visa page, so it was not carried over here without direct confirmation. No distinct official Vanuatu visa photo specification could be located.
